ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu; FCAE contract course; No class during Thanksgiving/Fall Break on November 21st. Elluminate software will be provided--software and course will operate on dial-up and broadband connections, student will need to have an external computer microphone, and course information packet will be mailed to the student after registration only, so timely registration is encouraged. $50 per student flat fee for materials. The course tuition will be covered by FCAE. Student is responsible for repayment of the tuition to FCAE if the course is not successfully completed. There will be NO EXTENSIONS given for the course.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign Miscellaneous Fees $50.00 Flat Fee, and Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign Miscellaneous Fees $50.00 Flat Fee.
